decisions.DB921: Merged unit design: one analysis unit per evaluated proc carrying both the readonly authored and Installed lowerings; admission requires measured runs across coverage, interprocedural, object_types, source_graph, SSA and DB tests.
decisions.package_survey_logical: Option (a): survey-scoped Logical conditional source control that walks first-match bodies as C Tcl does, plus registry form data for one-argument `package provide` and a decoded-child advice path; survey test assertions kept; Logical contract amended for that scope only.
decisions.forced_import_sibling_offsets: Move query offsets of the sibling import-lifecycle tests in definition.rs onto the call head word; fixtures and expected values unchanged unless tclsh contradicts them; recorded as test-input corrections.
decisions.test_only_lexical_helpers: Delete the test-only helpers in package reachability (original_data_word, script_of, command_source, bracketed_body, parse_vsatisfies, is_tcl_version_subject, is_requirement_word, cfg(test) Guard::TclSatisfies) with their only-caller assertions in reachability/tests.rs 489-527 and 567-587.
decisions.Server102_103: Snapshot consistency: answer from one captured snapshot revision per request (#1854); drop only if the snapshot itself is invalidated.
decisions.Server108: Reuse cached per-document analysis keyed on input revision; re-analyse only changed documents; 180 s budget unchanged.
